title: Subscription webhook keeps the local trial end when Stripe sends trial_end as null

bugs.note: customer.subscription.updated sends trial_end: null when the trial is ended early or removed. isset() is false for null, so the branch is skipped and trial_ends_at keeps the old future date. The app keeps treating the subscription as on trial (onTrial, trial-only access, trial-period logic in billing) after Stripe has started charging, or after the trial was cut short.
